title: Directors’ identity verification for an overseas company (OS VS01)
text:
All overseas company directors must have:

 • completed identity verification

 • their Companies House personal code

 You’ll need to file a form OS VS01 to confirm all company directors have verified their identity, unless you’ve already provided this information. Complete one form for each company and include details for all directors. If the company has more than 2 directors, use the continuation pages.

 You must do this by the anniversary of the date the UK establishment was opened. For example, if it was opened on 3 May 1995 you must file by 3 May 2026.

 You can only use this form for overseas companies. For UK companies, see Verifying your identity for Companies House .
changeNote: Clarified that you need to file one form OS VS01 for each company, and include details for all company directors on the form.
